description: This file 'wanmgr_utils.h' is a C header file that declares utility functions, macros, constants, and includes related to WAN management, such as starting, stopping, and restarting applications, process management, and system information retrieval.

methods.name: WanManager_DoStartApp
methods.description: Starts an application with given name and command line arguments, returns the process ID.

methods.name: WanManager_DoRestartApp
methods.description: Restarts a specified application with given arguments, returns the process ID.

methods.name: WanManager_DoStopApp
methods.description: Stops the application specified by name.

methods.name: WanManager_DoCollectApp
methods.description: Cleans up zombie processes for the given application.

methods.name: WanManager_DoSystemAction
methods.description: Executes a system command from the caller.

methods.name: WanManager_DoSystemActionWithStatus
methods.description: Executes a system command and returns the status.

methods.name: CollectApp
methods.description: Collects zombie processes based on process ID.

methods.name: WanManager_StartIpoeHealthCheckService
methods.description: Starts the IPoE health check service, returns PID on success.

methods.name: WanManager_StopIpoeHealthCheckService
methods.description: Stops the IPoE health check service.

methods.name: GetPathToApp
methods.description: Finds the system path of a specified application.

methods.name: WanManager_GetDateAndUptime
methods.description: Retrieves current system date and uptime.

methods.name: WanManager_getUpTime
methods.description: Returns system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: util_spawnProcess
methods.description: Spawns a new process with given executable and info, returns process ID.

methods.name: util_terminateProcessForcefully
methods.description: Forcibly terminates a process by PID.

methods.name: util_signalProcess
methods.description: Sends a signal to a process specified by PID.

methods.name: util_getPidByName
methods.description: Retrieves the PID of a process given its name and arguments.

methods.name: util_getNameByPid
methods.description: Retrieves process name given a PID.

methods.name: util_collectProcess
methods.description: Collects (waits for) a process to terminate.

methods.name: util_runCommandInShellBlocking
methods.description: Runs a shell command in blocking mode.

methods.name: util_getZombiePidByName
methods.description: Finds zombie processes by process name.

methods.name: WanManager_Util_GetShell_output
methods.description: Reads output from a FILE pointer into a buffer.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetRestartWanInfo
methods.description: Sets WAN restart information.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateCfg
methods.description: Updates configuration during restart based on parameters.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateCfg_Bool
methods.description: Updates boolean configuration during restart.

methods.name: sysctl_iface_set
methods.description: Sets system interface parameters.
